		]
		values = [
			False,
			'',
		]
		system.tag.writeBlocking(tagPaths, values)
		client = core.apiClient.Client()
		paths = [
			"[WHK01]WH/WHK01/Distillery01/Mashing01/Cooker02/Buffer/ActualData",
#				"[WHK01]WH/WHK01/Distillery01/Mashing01/Cooker02/Buffer/ActualInitData",
			"[WHK01]WH/WHK01/Distillery01/Mashing01/Cooker02/Buffer/ParameterData",
		]
		tags = system.tag.readBlocking(paths)
			
		try:
			
			actualData = tags[0].value[0].toDict()
			parameterData = tags[1].value
			
			actualDataJson = system.util.jsonEncode(actualData)
#			parameterDataJson = system.util.jsonEncode(parameterData)	
			postQuery = '''{{
			    "createdBy": "{}",
			    "operation": "{}",
			    "parameterData": {},
			    "batchData": {}
			}}'''.format(
				'MES',
				'Mashing01',
				parameterData,
				actualDataJson
			)
			
#			system.tag.writeBlocking("[.]Debug", postQuery)
			
			batch = system.util.jsonDecode(client.postQuery(postQuery, '/batches/batch-id', None))
			if isinstance(batch, dict):
				if batch.get('error',''):
					# api error
					tagPaths = [
					"[WHK01]WH/WHK01/Distillery01/Mashing01/Cooker02/Buffer/Error",
					"[WHK01]WH/WHK01/Distillery01/Mashing01/Cooker02/Buffer/ErrorMessage",
				]
					values = [
						True,
						batch['error'],
					]
					system.tag.writeBlocking(tagPaths, values)
					system.tag.writeBlocking("[WHK01]WH/WHK01/Distillery01/Mashing01/Cooker02/Buffer/CreateBatchRecordTrigger",False)
				else:
					system.tag.writeBlocking([
							"[.]Debug",
							"[WHK01]WH/WHK01/Distillery01/Mashing01/Cooker02/Buffer/CreateBatchRecordTrigger"
						],
						[
							batch,
							False
							]
					)
			else:
				# other error
				tagPaths = [
					"[WHK01]WH/WHK01/Distillery01/Mashing01/Cooker02/Buffer/Error",
					"[WHK01]WH/WHK01/Distillery01/Mashing01/Cooker02/Buffer/ErrorMessage",
				]
				values = [
					True,
					str(batch),
				]
				system.tag.writeBlocking(tagPaths, values)
				system.tag.writeBlocking("[WHK01]WH/WHK01/Distillery01/Mashing01/Cooker02/Buffer/CreateBatchRecordTrigger",False)
		
		except Exception as e: 
			tagPaths = [
					"[WHK01]WH/WHK01/Distillery01/Mashing01/Cooker02/Buffer/Error",
					"[WHK01]WH/WHK01/Distillery01/Mashing01/Cooker02/Buffer/ErrorMessage",
				]
			values = [
				True,
				repr(e),
			]
			system.tag.writeBlocking(tagPaths, values)
			system.tag.writeBlocking("[WHK01]WH/WHK01/Distillery01/Mashing01/Cooker02/Buffer/CreateBatchRecordTrigger",False)
